subject.title: fix(openai): prevent onboarding from offering unavailable account models

question: Should this compatibility-sensitive OpenAI onboarding and release-acceptance change be accepted after maintainers confirm the supplemental catalog preserves configured and non-runtime provider routes for existing users?
rationale: The patch changes account/provider model selection and release gating, and the item is explicitly labeled `maintainer`; the repository policy reserves that product and upgrade judgment for maintainers even when focused tests are green.

options.title: Review and merge with compatibility proof
options.body: Confirm the focused catalog cases cover configured, static, refreshable, and runtime-discovered providers plus fresh-install and repeated-onboarding behavior, then merge the focused fix.

options.title: Narrow the catalog change
options.body: Keep the release-acceptance coverage but revise the supplemental-selection boundary if maintainers identify an existing provider route that should not be filtered by account discovery.

recommendation.title: Review and merge with compatibility proof
recommendation.body: Confirm the focused catalog cases cover configured, static, refreshable, and runtime-discovered providers plus fresh-install and repeated-onboarding behavior, then merge the focused fix.
